title.en: Eliminating Hotel Linen Shrinkage with RFID and Python Automation
title.id: Menghilangkan Kehilangan Linen Hotel dengan RFID & Otomasi Python
title.zh: 利用RFID与Python自动化消除酒店布草流失损耗
title.ja: RFIDとPython自動化でホテルのリネン紛失ロスをゼロにする
title.ko: RFID 및 Python 자동화로 호텔 린넨 유실 및 세탁 손실을 방지한 사례

desc.en: How an 80-room resort in Ubud reduced missing towels and sheets by 91% using UHF RFID laundry tags and automatic weight validation.
desc.id: Bagaimana resort 80 kamar di Ubud memangkas kehilangan handuk dan sprei hingga 91% dengan tag RFID UHF dan validasi timbangan otomatis.
desc.zh: 乌布一家拥有80间客房的度假村如何通过UHF超高频洗涤标签与自动称重，将毛巾和被单丢失率降低91%。
desc.ja: ウブドの80室リゾートでUHF RFIDランドリータグと重量自動測定を活用し、紛失を91％削減した事例。
desc.ko: 우붓의 80개 객실 리조트에서 UHF RFID 세탁 태그와 자동 중량 검증 시스템으로 린넨 분실을 91% 줄인 방법.

body.en:
How an 80-room resort in Ubud reduced missing towels and sheets by 91% using UHF RFID laundry tags and automatic weight validation.

The Hidden Drain of Hotel Linen Discrepancies

In tropical Indonesian resorts, bedsheets, pool towels, and duvet covers cycle constantly between housekeeping closets, guest villas, and third-party commercial laundries. Without automated tracking, missing inventory is blamed on guest theft when 70% is lost in transit or unrecorded vendor wash cycles.

91%reduction in missing linen inventory
Rp 22Mmonthly replacement cost saved
1.2sscan time per 50-item laundry bag

Flexible UHF RFID Silicone Tags

We stitched heat-resistant, waterproof UHF RFID micro-transponders into the hem of 4,000 linen items. Capable of surviving 200 industrial wash and iron cycles, the tags allow entire laundry hampers to be inventoried in under two seconds.

Dual Verification: Weight vs Electronic Counts

At the vendor loading bay, hampers pass over an integrated floor scale while an overhead RFID antenna array reads every tag. Cross-referencing physical gross weight against tag counts detects wet items and prevents unaccounted losses.

Bulk RFID Tag Reader & Weight Validator
import serial

def read_laundry_consignment(scale_port: str, rfid_reader):
    scale = serial.Serial(scale_port, baudrate=9600, timeout=1)
    weight_raw = scale.readline().decode('utf-8').strip()
    gross_weight_kg = float(weight_raw.replace('KG', ''))

    tags = rfid_reader.scan_inventory_tags(duration_ms=1000)
    expected_weight = sum([tag.nominal_weight_kg for tag in tags])

    discrepancy = abs(gross_weight_kg - expected_weight)
    if discrepancy > 1.5:
        trigger_audit_flag(gross_weight_kg, expected_weight, len(tags))
    return {"scanned_count": len(tags), "weight_kg": gross_weight_kg}

Automatic Consignment Slips via WhatsApp

Upon scanning, a digital handover slip is automatically dispatched to the laundry contractor manager on WhatsApp with exact counts of pillowcases, bath towels, and duvet covers, completely cutting vendor disputes.
